stem:
Meera ties a stone to a string to make a simple pendulum at home. She starts her stopwatch and finds that the pendulum completes 20 full oscillations in 40 seconds.
What is the time period of the pendulum?

teacher.key_rationale: Time period = total time / number of oscillations = 40 s / 20 = 2 s. Option A inverts the division, C and D simply restate the measured values.
